title: ericameria parryi var. vulcanica
intro: Ericameria parryi var. vulcanica, commonly known as Mountain Mahogany Chrysanthemum, is a plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine to promote overall well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the relief of symptoms associated with conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Ericameria parryi var. vulcanica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
